checked_profile.summary: Student refinancing with separate options for standard borrowing, Parent PLUS and certain professional borrowers.
checked_profile.scope: This check covers the refinance process and loan categories described in SoFi’s help center. It does not verify a universal fee policy, advertised APR, employment benefit or individual approval.

facts.label: Checking a rate
facts.text: SoFi describes prequalification as a soft credit check. A full application includes document review and a hard credit inquiry that may affect your credit score. Prequalification is not final approval.

facts.label: Program differences
facts.text: The help center distinguishes standard, Parent PLUS, medical/dental residency and SmartStart options. The payment structure available to you depends on the program and eligibility.

facts.label: Partial refinancing
facts.text: SoFi says applicants can refinance only part of their eligible student debt. Identify the specific loans and amounts in the application rather than assuming every existing loan must move.

questions: Which program applies to me, and when do full principal-and-interest payments begin?
